title: Decide GET /checkin + GET /rollcall exposure policy
description:
Gate GET /checkin and GET /rollcall behind OSCORE authentication.

## Decision: OSCORE-only read access

Rationale:
- Presence/location is sensitive - don't leak to passive observers
- Authenticated peers already have EDHOC context, no extra cost
- Preserves peer discovery for legitimate mesh participants
- Pattern: write=admin, read=OSCORE, unauthenticated=nothing

## Action
1. Add OSCORE verification to GET handlers in checkin_resource
2. Return 4.01 Unauthorized for non-OSCORE requests
3. Update spec 18.6.1 and 18.6.3 to document authentication requirement
4. Add test vectors for unauthenticated GET rejection

## Files to modify
- lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin_resource.c (GET handlers)
- spec/12-apps.md section 18.6
- test/vectors/checkin*.json (add rejection vectors)
notes: 2026-08-28: Human decision - OSCORE-only for presence reads. Privacy without breaking discovery.
